newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent indicated firmer, NYMEX steady.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent indicated firmer, NYMEX steady.

text.p: SIMEX Brent November futures were indicated slightly firmer in late trading on Monday amid little direction.
November was untraded but quoted at $22.00/$22.10 per barrel, firmer than London's Friday settlement of $21.99.
Brokers said the market found little direction on Monday with the exception of a firmer London gas oil market late in the session.
October gas oil was up $2.00 per tonne at $216.00 in early London dealings.

November NYMEX, which closed 12 cents higher at $23.22 in New York on Friday, was last traded at $23.25 but bid at $23.21 on the overnight ACCESS system. The market was steady for most of the Asian day.
One broker said tight product supplies and the delayed Iraq oil-for-food deal maintained a bullish background for the market but there was little fresh incentive for the market to rally.
This broker said he expected front-month Brent to range $21.68 to $22.35 in the absence of fresh news.
